title: Google Slides & Content Creation Tools | Design, Color Theory & Animations
notes:
This session blends content creation tools with Google Slides mastery to help you create professional, engaging, and visually appealing presentations.

👉 What we covered in this session:

Introduction to content creation tools: condenser microphones, Adobe Photoshop, Google Keep
Using Google Keep + ChatGPT to turn ideas into full social media posts
Social media management with Metricool: scheduling & cross-platform posting
Introduction to Google Slides: interface, themes, and setup
Generating presentation outlines & content with ChatGPT (e.g., financial literacy talk)
Text formatting & advanced tools: fonts, format painter, highlighting
Slide alignment, duplication & structuring content for readability
Color theory for presentations: choosing readable color schemes & brand identity
Inserting, resizing & formatting images (opacity, brightness, drop shadows, etc.)
Arranging objects, layering, and replacing images in Slides
Slide backgrounds, consistency & professional branding
Animations & transitions (fade, cube, zoom-in, appear on click, etc.)
Creating master slides with permanent logos & templates
Collaboration: sharing presentations with controlled permissions
Export options: PDF & PowerPoint formats for professional delivery
Q&A highlights: captions, background images, creative color use, master slides, animations

💡 Practical Tip: Google Slides isn’t just for classwork — you can use it to design company profiles, pitch decks, and marketing presentations that look polished and professional without needing heavy tools like Photoshop.

title: How to Use ChatGPT for Blogging, Social Media & Business Analysis
notes:
In this session, we explored ChatGPT — not just as a Q&A bot, but as a productivity and creativity tool for blogging, social media, business insights, and even personal growth.

What we covered in this session:

Writing full blog posts with ChatGPT (example: top 10 cameras for content creators in Kenya)
Generating social media content: Facebook, LinkedIn & Instagram posts
Advanced prompting: satire, humor, long-form posts, and sensitive topics (like gambling)
Using Google Keep to store AI-generated content for later use
Ethical concerns: authenticity, AI in love letters, and the role of human input
ChatGPT for learning: explaining complex topics like SEO & data science in simple words
Uploading Excel files into ChatGPT for KPI & data analysis
Business use: AI as a tool to make or save money
AI in publishing & creative work: why human contribution still matters
Social media scheduling tools: Buffer & Metricool for weekly planning
Social media monetization: why platform payouts are low & how to monetize through services/products
Building traffic & engagement: why buying followers doesn’t work, and why authenticity fake numbers
AI as a mental health support tool: journaling, companionship, and personal reflection

💡 Practical Tip: ChatGPT is not here to replace you — it’s here to think with you. The more effort you put into prompts, the more authentic and valuable your output becomes.

📌 Next Steps

Practice creating a blog post with ChatGPT and refine it in Google Docs.
Try generating and scheduling a week of social media posts using Metricool or Buffer.
Use ChatGPT to analyze a small Excel file — experiment with KPIs or personal finance data.

title: Welcome & The Reality of Making Money Online
notes:
Welcome & The Reality of Making Money Online
In this opening lesson, you’ll be welcomed into the course and introduced to the real purpose behind it: helping you turn the skills you already have into income. You’ll learn why having skills alone is not enough, why many freelancers struggle to get paid, and why the modern economy rewards problem-solvers—not certificates. Through real-life examples from my own journey, this lesson sets the foundation for thinking like a structured freelancer or service provider who knows how to package value and sell it online.

What You’ll Learn

Why most people have skills but still struggle financially
The difference between having a skill and offering a solution
Why the world pays for problems solved, not talent alone
How this course will help you package and sell your services the right way
How to approach the course for maximum results
